label: Saturated near 1; dips accelerating over the last ten trials, deeper after unrewarded trials.
terms: np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0) ;; np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0)**2 ;; np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0) * belief_lo ;; np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0) * (prev_common == 0) ;; np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0) * (phase==D1) ;; np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0) * (prev_action == 1) ;; np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0) * (phase==D2)*(in_state==2)*(in_action==1)
explanation: z unit 3 sits at ~0.9999 (std 0.002) and only moves at the very end of the episode. Almost all explainable variance beyond the per-decile baseline is a within-last-decile timing ramp: the gate drops steadily and accelerates over trials 90-99 (linear + quadratic in ep_trial-90 alone gives dev R2 0.36). Trial-history content is weak (profile all ceiling 0.07, all observed 0.05) and mostly acts as a late-episode modulation: the dip is deeper after an unrewarded trial (short-form third term, +0.02), and in the free fit also after rare transitions, after a1 choices, with S1-leaning belief, and at D2 after a1 reaching S2 (free fit dev 0.42). The short form is mostly finer timing, not history, so the verdict is partial even though the R2 is near the explained threshold.
